body:
### Summary

`uv lock` selects Pympler 1.1 and pywin32 312, but that lock fails on free-threaded Windows Python 3.13. Pympler 1.0.1 works for both builds.

Some form of this happens with all the universal Python lockers I tested (uv, Poetry, PDM, and nab), partly because I don't think any lock file format (standard or non-standard) allows you to express marker selection based on free-threadedness.

```toml
[project]
name = "repro"
version = "0"
requires-python = ">=3.13,<3.14"
dependencies = ["pympler"]

[tool.uv]
environments = ["sys_platform == 'win32'"]
required-environments = ["sys_platform == 'win32'"]
```

```console
uv lock --python 3.13
uv sync --locked --dry-run --python 3.13t --python-platform x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
```

Sync output:

```text
Using CPython 3.13.12+freethreaded
Would create project environment at: <project-env>
Resolved 3 packages in 0.73ms
error: Distribution `pywin32==312 @ registry+https://pypi.org/simple` can't be installed because it doesn't have a source distribution or wheel for the current platform
```

The result is unchanged with `--python 3.13t` when locking or `fork-strategy="fewest"`.

### Platform

Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS, x86_64 (WSL2); target: Windows AMD64

### Version

uv 0.13.8 (x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu)

### Python version

CPython 3.13.12 and CPython 3.13.12+freethreaded
title: Universal Windows lock cannot sync on free-threaded Python 3.13
